title: Product Owner gate dependency recovery and live deployment repair
objective: Repair the live-acceptance blockers discovered at the authoritative Product Owner gate without bypassing Product Owner authority: restore a deployable Keycloak-backed confirmation boundary, wire the existing Product Owner decision consumer into the production lifecycle, and add a strictly controlled audited recovery path for failure of the confirmation dependency itself.
requirements: Preserve the authoritative WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER hard gate; do not mark the task DONE or synthesize ACCEPT.

Implement a narrowly scoped, fail-closed, auditable Product Owner REQUEST_REWORK recovery mechanism for confirmation-dependency failure, bound to AIDP-INFRA-0002 and expected HEAD 091afb0025b2386e97d50daa5acd2913749adc1e, single-use/idempotent, never ACCEPT.
Wire Product Owner acceptance consumption into production watcher/lifecycle composition.
Pin an explicit supported Keycloak container version; never use latest for governed acceptance.
Make the realm importable while preserving password plus TOTP, confidential client, PKCE S256, Product Owner role and authorization/ACR policy.
Add an executable Docker realm-import/startup smoke test.
Retain DPAPI, ACL, loopback, TLS and audit protections.
Document pinned Keycloak version and live acceptance procedure.
Regression: real acceptance failed with Unrecognized field acrToLoAMapping in RealmRepresentation.
Run focused PO tests, git diff --check, and real Docker import smoke test.
acceptance: Dependency recovery can only produce REQUEST_REWORK.
Production lifecycle consumes recorded PO decisions.
Pinned Keycloak imports the shipped realm successfully.
Password plus TOTP and security controls remain enforced.
Focused tests and git diff --check pass.

product_owner_authorization.scope: rework contract creation only; no ACCEPT, DONE, merge, or gate bypass authority
